description: Fuzzy search of Mahonia's cited gear catalog by brand, product or kind of gear ("duplex", "zpacks", "quilt"). Each result carries a catalog id, the cited weight in grams and whether it is verified. Use get_catalog_product for every variant of one product.

query.description: Two characters or more; a single Chinese character is enough.

name: search_catalog

query.description: The query as searched: trimmed, at most 100 characters.

category.description: The catalog's category: shelter, sleep, pack, and so on.

gear_type.description: What kind of thing it is: Tent, Quilt, Trail runners.

id.description: The catalog row id, the one add_items and create_list take as catalog_id.

name.description: The product name, without brand or variant.

variant.description: Size, length or rating; null on a product sold one way.

verified.description: Whether the cited weight has been verified.

weight_g.description: The cited weight in grams, to a tenth.

title: Search the gear catalog
